title: ProofPack output document v1
description: D1 section 4. The document the renderer consumes. Sections not yet produced by the engine (calibration, robustness, comparison, drift, claims) are declared here with their shape so the schema is stable, but are permitted to be null or absent until their build day lands. The subgroups, subgroup_attributes and fairness blocks landed on build day 5 (stats.subgroups).

manifest.description: Build day 7 (E7, proofpack.manifest): every key present. F17 as measured (tests/test_manifest.py::test_f17_two_runs_in_one_process_differ_only_in_run_id_started_duration_s_and_the_ledger_count): two runs of the same input, criteria and mapping in one process; the test asserts that run_id and ledger_count differ, that no manifest key outside run_id, started, duration_s and ledger_count differs (started and duration_s may or may not, run to run), that ledger.acceptance_runs in the body reads 1 then 2, that input_sha256, criteria_sha256 and mapping_sha256 are equal, and that the JSON bytes are identical once those keys are blanked. watermark is the licence state the footer prints (D4 section 3): null, TRIAL, or 'LICENCE EXPIRED - not for submission'.

dev_rows.description: Build day 7 (carried item 27): rows whose dataset column reads dev, never analysed; rows_read = dev_rows + excluded_missing_label + excluded_missing_score + indeterminate + analysed.

excluded_missing_score.description: Rows that are not dev rows, whose y_true is present and whose prediction input is missing: a NaN score while a score column exists, otherwise a blank y_pred (a non-dev row missing both counts under excluded_missing_label, and a dev row under dev_rows; repair 2, repair 3 and repair 4 of build day 8; at 657ef11 a blank y_pred on a table without a score column was analysed as a negative prediction).

missingness.description: Build day 6 (stats.descriptive): per mapped column, the count and share of rows missing after the missing-token normalisation. Counts are integers; no share is rounded here.

overall.description: One key per declared operating point id, plus 'threshold_free'.

calibration_suppressed_reason.description: Build day 6. Where D1 section 4.2 puts suppressed_reason: null when the calibration block is present; when the block is null, the typed reason it was not computed (the score is not a probability of the positive class) with the declarations that decided it.

subgroup_attributes.description: Build day 5: one block per tabulated attribute (reference level, level order, heterogeneity footnote).

ledger.description: Build day 7 (E7, io.ledger; D4 section 11 item 6): the analysed test set's SHA-256, the acceptance runs recorded on it in the local ledger (including this run, when it carried criteria), the customer's declared limit (null when no ledger block was declared), and whether the count could be read.

criteria_results.description: Build day 7 (E7, proofpack.criteria). One row per criterion per level in scope, plus one per level for a fairness bound (criterion_id 'fairness:<criterion_of_interest>'). The only place in the document the words met / not_met / not_assessable appear. Every bound, statistic and comparator is the customer's; attainable_at_n / max_lower_bound_at_n are stats.attainability's Wilson bound at k = n, filled for ci_lower_bound criteria on proportion metrics whose Number's method is wilson and whose n is an integer above 0; on any other method both are null and detail.attainability_not_computed is 'method_not_wilson' whatever n (repair 1 of 21 September: at ab729d3 a cluster_bootstrap_percentile row was met with attainable_at_n false; repair 2: at 02d00c5 a zero_denominator row at n 0 carried no annotation - tests/test_criteria.py::test_a_method_none_number_at_n_zero_or_n_null_is_annotated_method_not_wilson). A Number with method none is not_assessable / no_interval under every statistic, point_estimate included (repair 1 of 21 September, B1).

claims.description: Build day 8 (E8, proofpack.narrate): the claims the checker accepted, one per sentence the renderer may print; each item is exactly the claims_schema.json item (tests/test_claims.py asserts the two are equal).

metric_id.description: D1 section 4.3's metric id enum (output_schema_v1.json $defs/metricId) or calibration_by_group, or null for a claim about no one metric.

comparator_id.description: On a difference claim, the difference block the second pointer reads; on a criterion claim, the row's comparator.

criterion_index.description: The position in criteria_results a criterion claim addresses (by position, never by id: two rows may share an id).

value_refs.description: RFC 6901 JSON pointers into run.json, each resolving to a Number object or a documented scalar.

guidance_ref.description: An internal_id present in design/guidance_map_v1.csv, or null.

free_text.description: Null at launch. When present the checker forbids a digit in any script, %, the verdict words, the section sign, CFR, guidance, and any claim of certification, approval, endorsement or clearance.

claim_rejections.description: Build day 8 (E8, proofpack.narrate.checker.resolve): every claim the checker rejected, with its typed reason; T8 section 7 prints the count and the codes. Empty when every engine claim was accepted.

suppression_log.description: Empty at launch: k-suppression applies on egress only (A-P2).

guidance_refs.description: Build day 8 (E8, proofpack.render.anchors): every guidance anchor the accepted claims cite, resolved through design/guidance_map_v1.csv. draft is structured data (D1 section 4.2; CLAUDE.md: the FDA AI-DSF guidance is a draft, January 2025, not for implementation, in prose and in data); label is built from the map row; url is the row's url or null.

declaration_index.description: Position of the criteria.yaml entry this row was evaluated from (a level: * entry yields one row per level, all with its index); null on the fairness-bound rows. Added in repair 1 of build day 8 so the renderer prints each row's own author, date and justification.

metric_ref.description: JSON path of the Number read, e.g. subgroups[3].metrics.op1.sensitivity.number; null when nothing could be read.

method.description: D1 section 4.1 enum. 'logit_delta' and 'newcombe11' were added on build day 2 (see handoffs/2026-09-08_E.md).

notEstimableReason.description: Typed reasons a quantity carries no interval. There is no untyped fallback. 'cases_span_both_groups' and 'insufficient_levels' were added on build day 5 (stats.subgroups). The six from 'score_not_probability' to 'fixed_by_outcome_stratification' were added on build day 6 (stats.calibration): two suppression reasons, three typed IRLS outcomes, and the reference Brier under an outcome-stratified resampler.

flag.description: Advisory annotations. The three added on build day 4 record the X2 clustered auto-switch and the small-class switch on the Number that is rendered; the typed reason itself rides on the companion analytic Number. 'newcombe_refused_clustered' (build day 5) rides on a subgroup difference computed by the two-sided cluster bootstrap because Newcombe method 10 was refused on clustered rows. The four from 'below_200_events_or_nonevents' (build day 6, stats.calibration): the 200/200 convention after Van Calster 2019 (an annotation, never a suppression - DEC-08), the boundary-score clip for the logit-scale models, and the X2 refusals of the log-delta O:E and the IRLS Wald intervals under clustering.

Number.description: Every rendered quantity (D1 section 4.1). Invariant: a Number either carries both interval bounds, or is suppressed, or names a typed not_estimable_reason. It is never possible to render an estimate whose uncertainty is unstated.

allOf.description: No Number without a CI: if either bound is null and it is not suppressed, a typed reason is mandatory and the method must be 'none'.
A Number with an interval names a real method and carries no reason.

operatingPointBlock.description: Threshold metrics at one operating point. Exactly one of sensitivity/ppa and one of specificity/npa is present: PPA/NPA when the reference standard is a non-reference comparator (FDA 2007), and then the words sensitivity/specificity must not appear.

auroc_wald.description: Secondary Wald interval, shown beside the logit interval (R2 section 1.3).

auprc.description: Deferred to v1.1; always null in v1.

suppressed_reason.description: Build day 8 (E8 item 1, E7 carried item 42): present only on a y_pred-only table, where no threshold-free statistic can exist; the auroc Number beside it carries not_computed_this_run and roc is empty.

prefixItems.description: null at the origin (build day 7: no finite threshold calls zero rows positive; canonical JSON refuses inf)

Cell.description: One rendered quantity with its audit trail (build day 4 CellCI.as_dict, D1 section 9): the Number the renderer prints, the companion analytic Number (a typed refusal under clustering, or the same Number when the analytic method was used), what became of the analytic method, the clustering route, and the bootstrap block (policy, usable resamples, the resampling quantities the refusal rule was measured on) when a resampler ran. 'detail' carries statistics that are not Numbers and never verdicts (z, p_value, variances for an AUROC difference; the declared score type for a Brier that was not computed).

subgroupOperatingPointMetrics.description: Per operating point inside a subgroup row: the 2x2 counts and every proportion metric as a Cell. Exactly one of sensitivity/ppa and one of specificity/npa is present (FDA 2007 routing).

subgroupOperatingPointDifferences.description: Per operating point: the level-minus-other difference of each proportion metric (Newcombe method 10, or the two-sided cluster bootstrap, or a typed refusal). Every value is null on the reference row's own diff_vs_reference.

subgroupDifferences.description: diff_vs_reference / diff_vs_complement: one key per operating point id plus 'auroc'. There is no diff_vs_overall anywhere (objection X1: the subgroup is part of the overall cohort).

subgroupRow.description: One level of one attribute (D1 section 4.2 'subgroups'; D4 section 5.3 row shape). is_unknown_row marks the explicit Unknown/missing row, which is never the reference. tier is the R2 section 3.3 precision tier measured in resampling units, or null.

heterogeneityTest.description: One exploratory homogeneity test (R2 section 3.4). Raw and Holm-adjusted p-values are detail, never a criterion: this object has no 'status' key and a test asserts it.

subgroupAttribute.description: Per-attribute block: the reference level and how it was chosen, the level order, the age bands and their source, the complement definition, and the exploratory heterogeneity footnote.

clustering_route.description: The run-level clustering route. Under 'declared' or 'detected' the row-level chi-square / Fisher tests are not run and every entry carries not_estimable_reason clustered_data_analytic_ci_invalid.

fairnessGap.description: One level's gaps against the reference level: the diff_vs_reference cells re-read as gaps (fpr_gap is the mirrored specificity difference), the AUROC gap, the selection-rate gap labelled descriptive_not_target, and calibration-by-group as null with a typed reason until the calibration day. No status key: the comparison to the bound is E7's.

eceEntry.description: One ECE figure with its binning scheme stated (R2 section 1.4: ECE is bin-sensitive; both schemes are reported and labelled supplementary). No interval is emitted for it in v1; the Number carries not_computed_this_run and ci_not_computed_because says why.

curveFlag.description: The 200/200 convention after Van Calster 2019 (R2 section 1.4): present when the analysed rows hold fewer than 200 events or fewer than 200 non-events. An annotation (DEC-08): the decile table, intercept, slope and O:E are still reported.

calibrationBlock.description: D1 section 4.2 'calibration' (build day 6, stats.calibration), computed only for a score declared as a probability of the positive class. Each quantity is a day-4 Cell (the rendered Number plus its companion analytic Number and clustering audit). suppressed_reason is null inside a present block; the top-level calibration_suppressed_reason carries the reason when the block is null.

table1Levels.description: attribute -> level -> {n, pct}. pct is the level's share of the rows tabulated (analysed test rows, or dev rows); the levels of one attribute sum to 1. Not rounded here.

table1Block.description: D1 section 4.2 'table1' (build day 6, stats.descriptive). dev is present only when the table carries dataset = dev rows; similarity and overlap are v1.1 and null, with the reason recorded in not_computed.

fairnessBlock.description: D1 section 4.2 'fairness' (R2 section 4): measured, never mitigated. criterion_of_interest and bound are the customer's declaration echoed verbatim; no status is emitted here.
